items.tldr: A single hacker used AI agents on the open-source Cairn platform to breach 100+ company websites (Deere, SharkNinja, Cummins) for roughly $5,000 in compute costs.
items.tldr_zh: 一名黑客利用开源平台 Cairn 上的 AI 智能体，仅花约 5000 美元算力费用，就攻破了 Deere、SharkNinja 等一百多家公司的网站。
items.take: The marginal cost of a breach just collapsed from「hire a team」to「spend $50 per target」-- so who exactly is the security industry's pricing model still protecting?
items.take_zh: 入侵一家公司的边际成本从「组建团队」暴跌到「50 美元一个目标」——现有安全产业的定价模型到底还在保护谁？

items.tldr: Disney agreed to hire ~60 Character.AI employees at $60M/year in compensation after the chatbot startup filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, with its new CTO being Character.AI's former CEO.
items.tldr_zh: Character.AI 申请破产后，迪士尼以年薪总计 6000 万美元的条件接收了约 60 名员工，其新任 CTO 正是 Character.AI 的前 CEO。
items.take: Disney didn't buy the product or the brand -- just the people who built the thing that got kids addicted and then went bankrupt; is this an acqui-hire or a liability laundering?
items.take_zh: 迪士尼没买产品也没买品牌——只挖走了那群让青少年上瘾、然后把公司搞破产的人；这算人才收购还是风险漂白？

items.tldr: A Northwestern University study found that visual reaction times are 41 milliseconds faster during exhalation than inhalation, regardless of alertness level.
items.tldr_zh: 西北大学研究发现，人在呼气时的视觉反应速度比吸气时快 41 毫秒，且与清醒程度无关。
items.take: Every competitive gamer already swears by breathing rituals -- but if a 41ms edge is real and phase-lockable, why isn't the first question whether it generalises to decisions, not reflexes?
items.take_zh: 电竞选手早就迷信呼吸节奏——但如果 41 毫秒的优势真实且可锁相，第一个该问的难道不是它对决策也成立吗？
